scientific_integrity: The derivation uses the explicit vertex-corner normal form, tensor multiplication and finite-field projection counts. All small-case checks were performed on complete independently enumerated endomorphism matrices; self-review only, with no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only unital algebra endomorphisms fixing the three distinguished vertex idempotents are counted. Three vertices, positive parallel-arrow multiplicities, free path algebra; no bound quivers or general vertex-moving morphisms. Finite checker verifies six instances, not the arbitrary-parameter proof. An equivalent broader result may exist under quiver transvection or filtered endomorphism terminology.
title: Vertex-fixed algebra retractions of bypass quivers: a rank polynomial with multiplicative gaps
